body:
Move and refactor/update references in skills and shared scripts runtime and configuration to project root folder .ws

same tree structure

treat this folder as commitable - git source controlled - do not ignore by default. If user wants, he adds to .gitignore on his own.

this folder structure will make sure it continues to be compatible with local and global workflow-skills installation

Example:
instead of {projectRoot}/.agents/skills/ws-shared folder, we will now use:
{projectRoot}/.ws

So instead of look for config.json in {projectRoot}/.agents/skills/ws-shared/config.json
will be now {projectRoot}/.ws/config.json

Update references in all skilss pointing to new workflow skill shared folder location.
title: change/update/move ws-shared folder location to {projectRoot}/.ws
